scripts.test:php: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:system: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/glaciate -- env GLACIATE_SYSTEM_TESTS=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-system.xml.dist
scripts.test:integration:forms: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/glaciate -- env GLACIATE_FORM_PLUGINS=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --group form-plugins
scripts.forms:plugins: wp-env run tests-cli wp plugin install https://downloads.wordpress.org/plugin/contact-form-7.6.2.4.zip https://downloads.wordpress.org/plugin/wpforms-lite.2.0.3.zip --force
scripts.check:licenses: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/glaciate sh -c 'composer licenses --no-dev --format=json | php bin/check-licenses.php'
scripts.i18n:check: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/glaciate sh -c "wp i18n make-pot . /tmp/glaciate.pot --slug=glaciate --domain=glaciate --exclude=vendor,node_modules,tests,receivers,bin,build,playwright-report,test-results 2>&1 | tee /tmp/glaciate-pot.log; ! grep -q Warning /tmp/glaciate-pot.log"
